projectDescription: A local-first infinite canvas for drawing, wireframing, and diagramming that runs in the browser or as a desktop app, with a shared Rust document engine, CLI, and MCP server for agent-assisted editing.
keyFeatures: Infinite canvas with shapes, arrows, text, Markdown, freehand strokes, frames, groups, and layers
Local-first document model using Automerge for history, merging, and offline editing
Native .inkfinite files with atomic writes, file locking, and recovery
Browser-based web editor with IndexedDB storage and WebAssembly document engine
Desktop app (Tauri) with native file handling and live CLI access via authenticated IPC
CLI (inkfinite) for inspecting, querying, editing, validating, and rendering documents
MCP server (inkfinite-mcp) for permissioned agent access with proposal review workflow
Import/export for SVG, Excalidraw, Obsidian Canvas, Mermaid, D2, PNG
Graph layout (tree, flow, radial), snapping, stencil library, and vector path editing
TypeScript packages (@inkfinite/core, @inkfinite/editor, @inkfinite/ui, @inkfinite/bindings) sharing one document contract with Rust
publicApiSurface: inkfinite new — Create a blank canonical document
inkfinite inspect — Print a document summary or materialized snapshot
inkfinite query — Find records by semantic, structural, kind, or bounds filters
inkfinite validate — Load and validate a canonical document
inkfinite shape / connect / layout — Build or edit a structured file or live desktop session
inkfinite apply — Validate and apply a transaction draft from JSON
inkfinite import svg — Import static SVG content into native shapes
inkfinite render — Write an SVG or PNG of a document or filtered view
inkfinite app — Inspect or work with a running desktop session
inkfinite completions — Print shell completion scripts (Bash, Fish, Zsh)
inkfinite schema / capabilities — Print machine-readable contracts
inkfinite-mcp — Stdio MCP server with read/write policy, proposals, and desktop session discovery
@inkfinite/core — Headless editor model, geometry, actions, interchange, and persistence
@inkfinite/editor — DOM input, interaction runtime, Canvas 2D renderer, transaction drafts
@inkfinite/bindings — Generated TypeScript contracts from Rust (DocumentSnapshot, EditorPatch, PathGeometry, etc.)
